scope: The GC-controlled 200-build scanner schedule also brackets each build with QueryProcessCycleTime. Process cycles sum all process threads and include kernel work, but are not elapsed time; CPU frequency, thread migration and ambient load may vary. Process CPU, wall, check and emit durations remain diagnostic. A cycle null must pass before a separate candidate cycle screen. Neither result alone establishes normal-GC check latency, complete native build time or the C-relative runtime gate.
